reservation_rule: Any data key with the cr_ prefix is reserved. Only ComRaid writes Reserved keys. The API rejects caller-supplied cr_ keys in Message create, Draft save, and Test send; pushsend assemble also drops caller Attribution keys before the Provider adapters write.

notes.fcm_covers: FCM Push payloads cover Android Endpoints only. iOS Endpoints are APNs-only (the iOS SDK registers APNs tokens only). The APNs block the FCM builder still attaches is outside this contract.
notes.fcm_only_hints: cr_priority and cr_android_channel_id are FCM-only, as intended. They never appear on APNs alert or APNs data-only payloads.
notes.live_activity: Live activity keys ride on an FCM data-only message and are read by the Android SDK only. iOS Live Activities use Apple's own liveactivity push (aps.content-state), which carries no cr_ keys.

keys.name: cr_title
keys.meaning: Notification title for SDK presentation and receive events.

keys.name: cr_body
keys.meaning: Notification body for SDK presentation and receive events.

keys.name: cr_data_only
keys.meaning: Marks a Data-only Notification so SDKs skip system-tray presentation until presentNotification.

keys.name: cr_image_url
keys.meaning: Image URL shown with the Notification.

keys.name: cr_deep_link
keys.meaning: Deep link opened when the Notification is tapped.

keys.name: cr_actions
keys.meaning: Action buttons for the Notification.

keys.name: cr_sound
keys.meaning: Sound name. On APNs alert, sound is written to aps.sound instead (default "default" when blank).

keys.name: cr_subtitle
keys.meaning: Subtitle text. On APNs alert, subtitle is written to aps.alert.subtitle instead.

keys.name: cr_badge
keys.meaning: App badge count. On APNs alert, badge is written to aps.badge as an integer instead.

keys.name: cr_thread_id
keys.meaning: Thread / grouping id. On APNs alert, thread is written to aps.thread-id instead.

keys.name: cr_android_channel_id
keys.meaning: Android Category channel id for SDK-drawn trays. FCM-only; never present on APNs.

keys.name: cr_priority
keys.meaning: Android delivery priority hint. Present only when priority is normal; absent means high. FCM-only; never present on APNs.

keys.name: cr_message_id
keys.meaning: Message id for Delivery attribution.

keys.name: cr_delivery_id
keys.meaning: Delivery id for acks and open tracking.

keys.name: cr_message_recipient_id
keys.meaning: Message recipient id when the Delivery has one.

presence.fcm_data: when Delivery with a message recipient
presence.apns_alert: when Delivery with a message recipient
presence.apns_data_only: when Delivery with a message recipient

keys.name: cr_attribution_token
keys.meaning: Opaque token required to acknowledge delivered or opened.

keys.name: cr_activity_id
keys.meaning: Developer-chosen id of the Live activity this data message belongs to.

keys.name: cr_activity_type
keys.meaning: Developer-chosen type of the Live activity, for example delivery.

keys.name: cr_activity_op
keys.meaning: What to do with the Live activity: start, update or end.

keys.name: cr_activity_title
keys.meaning: Title the Android SDK draws in the ongoing live update.

keys.name: cr_activity_body
keys.meaning: Body the Android SDK draws in the ongoing live update.

keys.name: cr_activity_progress
keys.meaning: Progress from 0 to 100 for the progress style.

keys.name: cr_activity_status_text
keys.meaning: Short status text shown with the progress.
